title: I Would Be Like Jesus
lyrics: [G]Earthly [Gdim]pleasures [G]vainly call me; I would be like [Am7]Jesus;
[G]Be like [C]Jesus, [A7]this my song, [D]In the [D7]home and [G]in the throng;
That my soul may serve Him better,
All the way from earth to glory,
Telling o'er and o'er the story,
That in Heaven He may meet me,
That His words "Well done" may greet me,
